block-guide:
CORE/SPACER Empty vertical space between blocks. Space inside a section or between its children is usually better as the parent's padding or blockGap; a spacer is for a one-off gap. MARKUP (checked in the editor)
The HTML is always this one empty
, attributes in this order: style, aria-hidden, class. HEIGHT height is a string with a unit ("48px", "3rem") or a spacing preset "var:preset|spacing|" (written var(--wp--preset--spacing--) in the style). Without height in the comment the default is 100px, and the HTML must still say style="height:100px". The value in the comment and the inline style must match, or the block is invalid. Inside a Row (flex group) a horizontal spacer uses width: {"height":"0px","width":"72px"} -> style="height:0px;width:72px". CHECK Reopen the editor (no invalid notice); the gap on the front has the expected size.
